title: Design: the admin command header on phones
why: Jason, 2026-11-19, on the System Control Board at 390px: "Command needs help". The command header took three rows (127px) and cut the module name ("10. System Co"). Now, below 768px only: row one is Back, the sections dropdown (it names the page), the board light and Shortcuts; row two only the page's own filter and the tools at hand. The module's name gives way on phones (Back returns to the module). CSS only, in kit-css.php's phone block; desktop unchanged.
